evals.name: logo-sting-northwind
evals.prompt: Can you make a 3-second animated logo sting for my company Northwind? Our colors are navy #0A1F44 and gold #F2B705, and the mark should read NORTHWIND. I need it as a transparent overlay for OBS and also an MP4 for YouTube intros.
evals.expected_output: A HyperFrames project rendering a 3s 1920x1080 logo sting in brand navy/gold with the exact wordmark NORTHWIND; a transparent WebM (or ProRes MOV) overlay plus an MP4. Lint and check pass.
expectations: Delivers a transparent overlay file (WebM or MOV)
Delivers an opaque MP4 for YouTube
The wordmark NORTHWIND appears verbatim
Brand navy #0A1F44 is applied
Brand gold #F2B705 is applied
The clip is ~3 seconds (2.7-3.3s)
The render is 1920x1080
The overlay carries a real alpha channel
hyperframes lint reports 0 errors
hyperframes check is clean

evals.name: stat-hit-reels
evals.prompt: I need a count-up stat graphic for a pitch deck: '2,400 stores' with the label 'NOW SERVING' and context 'up from 1,900 last year'. Make it vertical 9:16 for Instagram Reels, about 4 seconds. Use a clean minimal look.
evals.expected_output: A 1080x1920, ~4s stat-hit that counts up to exactly 2,400, shows label NOW SERVING and context 'up from 1,900 last year', rendered as MP4. Lint and check pass.

evals.name: lower-third-helios
evals.prompt: Make a lower third for an interview with Dr. Lena Ortiz, VP of Engineering at Helios. Brand is minimal black and white with a teal accent #14B8A6. It should sit over footage at the bottom left and be a transparent overlay I can drop into Premiere.
evals.expected_output: A transparent lower-third overlay (WebM or ProRes MOV) with the name 'Dr. Lena Ortiz' and role 'VP of Engineering at Helios' copied verbatim from the brief, teal accent #14B8A6, anchored lower-left, 1920x1080, clean first/last frames. hyperframes check is clean and verify.mjs --expect-copy passes for both exact strings.
expectations: Delivers a transparent overlay file (WebM or MOV)
The name is exactly "Dr. Lena Ortiz"
The role is exactly "VP of Engineering at Helios"
Teal accent #14B8A6 is applied
The lower third is anchored lower-left (not centered)
The render is 1920x1080
The overlay carries a real alpha channel
The clip ends with the overlay fully off screen
hyperframes lint reports 0 errors
hyperframes check is clean

evals.name: multi-scene-promo-voiced
evals.prompt: Make a 20-second 16:9 promo for my coffee subscription brand Roast. Scenes: an opening title card with 'Roast', a word-by-word message 'Fresh roasted. / Delivered weekly. / Never stale.', a stat hit '12,000 subscribers' with the label 'BREWING SINCE 2019', and a logo close with roast.coffee. Add a voice-over reading one line per scene, and a subtle music bed under it. Vertical cut for Reels too.
evals.expected_output: A multi-scene HyperFrames project: a root timeline hosting four nested compositions (title card, kinetic type, stat hit, logo close) totalling ~20s, with the exact numbers/copy and the exact URL. A voice-over resolved through the first available provider (HeyGen/ElevenLabs/local) with a stated path, a music bed ducked under the voice (stated target, matched with normalize-audio), and both 16:9 and 9:16 renders. hyperframes check is clean and every asset is a frozen local file.

evals.name: multi-scene-multiaspect
evals.prompt: I need a 20-second promo for my coffee brand Roast. Structure it as four beats: an opening with 'Roast' and the line 'Fresh roasted, delivered weekly.', a word-by-word statement 'Fresh roasted. / Delivered weekly. / Never stale.', a stat hit of 12,000 subscribers labelled 'BREWING SINCE 2019', and a closing logo with roast.coffee. I also want a vertical 9:16 cut for Reels.
evals.expected_output: A multi-scene HyperFrames project built from a storyboard: one root timeline hosting four nested compositions (title card, kinetic type, stat hit, logo close) totalling ~20s, with 'Roast', 'Fresh roasted, delivered weekly.', '12,000', 'BREWING SINCE 2019' and 'roast.coffee' copied verbatim. Both a 16:9 and a 9:16 project exist (re-authored, not stretched) and render; hyperframes check is clean on both.
expectations: A storyboard file drives the build (storyboard.json or ASSEMBLY.md present)
The root timeline hosts four named scenes as nested compositions
Total duration is ~20 seconds (19-21s)
The four scenes tile the timeline with no unexplained gap
'Fresh roasted, delivered weekly.' appears verbatim
'BREWING SINCE 2019' appears verbatim
'12,000' appears verbatim
'roast.coffee' appears verbatim
A 16:9 project renders successfully
A 9:16 project is re-authored (1080x1920), not stretched from 16:9
hyperframes check is clean on the 16:9 project

evals.name: assets-ledger-deliver
evals.prompt: Build a 4-second lower third for Ana Ribeiro, Head of Coffee at Roast, and get it ready to ship. Freeze whatever assets it needs into the project, run the QA gate, then produce the delivery set: a transparent WebM and a ProRes MOV for the editor, plus a manifest of what was produced and where it came from. Brand is near-black with a warm orange accent #E4572E.
evals.expected_output: A transparent lower-third overlay with 'Ana Ribeiro' and 'Head of Coffee at Roast' copied verbatim and the #E4572E accent. Assets are frozen local files with a provenance ledger (assets/asset-ledger.json). verify.mjs runs the full gate. deliver.mjs produces the named deliverables and writes renders/deliverables.json; the overlay's alpha is verified by probe.
expectations: assets/asset-ledger.json exists and records at least one asset with provenance
No paid AI-generation provider was called (local/free paths only)
Re-running the same asset resolve reuses the frozen file (no duplicate ledger entry)
The QA gate (verify.mjs) ran
renders/deliverables.json exists and lists the produced files
A transparent WebM deliverable is produced
A ProRes MOV deliverable is produced (outputs/ or masters/)
The overlay's alpha is verified present
The copy is verbatim: 'Ana Ribeiro' and 'Head of Coffee at Roast'
